items.description: The Fig. 1(a) caption (repeated in Fig. 2) says only 'discretized by 30×60 elements'. It never says which count is horizontal; only the missing figure shows the aspect ratio. A cantilever clamped on the left is usually 2:1 wide, but listing 30 first also fits nelx=30, nely=60.
readings: 60 elements horizontal × 30 vertical (2:1 cantilever; clamped left edge is 30 elements tall)
30 elements horizontal × 60 vertical (1:2 tall domain; clamped left edge is 60 elements tall)

items.entity: Downward 1 N load at the lower-right corner
items.description: The Fig. 1(a) caption calls it a 'distributed load' but applies it 'at the lower-right corner'. The text does not give the loaded length or number of nodes, which edge(s) carry it, or how it is shared between nodes; only the missing figure shows this. Sect. 3.1 just points back to Fig. 1.
readings: Single point force at the bottom-right corner node
Spread equally over the lowest 3–4 nodes of the right edge (bottom 2–3 elements, about 5–10% of the edge height)
Spread equally over the last 3–4 nodes of the bottom edge next to the corner (about 5% of the length)
Spread over a few nodes on both edges that meet at the corner

items.description: The Fig. 1(a) caption says 'distributed load of 1 N'. It does not say whether 1 N is the total force, the force on each loaded node, or a force per unit length (which would also need the missing element size).
readings: 1 N total, split over the loaded nodes
1 N on each loaded node
1 N per unit length over the loaded length

items.entity: Physical dimensions / element size of the 2-D domain
items.description: The text gives only element counts (30×60). There is no physical length, height or element size anywhere; the filter radius is given in element units. If elements are square, this only rescales compliance.
readings: Unit square elements (h = 1; domain 60×30 or 30×60 units)
Domain length 2 × height 1 (h = 1/30)
Domain length 1 × height 0.5 (h = 1/60)

items.description: No thickness is given for the 2-D cantilever. Sect. 3.1 gives a thickness ('5 elements') only for the separate 3-D variant.

items.entity: Young's modulus of the solid material
items.description: No elastic modulus is given anywhere for the structural examples (Fig. 1 caption, Sect. 2, Sect. 3.1).
readings: E0 = 1 (normalised)
E0 = 210 GPa (steel)
E0 = 70 GPa (aluminium)

items.description: The paper never gives a Poisson's ratio for the linear-elastic model.

items.entity: 2-D constitutive assumption (plane stress vs plane strain)
items.description: The 2-D cantilever is described only as 'linear elasticity' (Sect. 2, Eq. 13). Plane stress vs plane strain is not stated; the choice changes the effective Poisson behaviour.
readings: Plane stress
Plane strain

items.description: SIMP appears only in general terms in the Introduction. The experiments never state the interpolation scheme or the penalty exponent. The p = 10 in the Fig. 1 caption is the p-norm stress exponent, not a SIMP penalty.
readings: SIMP, penalty 3 (fixed)
SIMP, penalty raised by continuation from 1 to 3
SIMP, penalty 4
SIMP, penalty 5

items.description: Sect. 2 gives ρ_min = ε only as an example ('e.g., ε≈10^-6'). Sect. 3.1 says only 'small lower bound ρ_min > 0'. It is not stated whether stiffness is E = ρ^p·E0 with ρ ≥ ρ_min, or a modified SIMP with a separate E_min.
readings: ρ_min = 1e-6 with E = ρ^p·E0
ρ_min = 1e-3 with E = ρ^p·E0
ρ in [0,1] with modified SIMP, E_min = 1e-9·E0

items.entity: MMA move limit η_max for the Fig. 1 standard run
items.description: The Fig. 1 caption lists MMA but no move limit. η_max = 0.2 is stated only for the standard runs of Fig. 10 (Sect. 3.1) and Fig. 14 (Sect. 3.2). The Fig. 3 caption says the only change from Fig. 1 is cutting η_max to 0.01 after iteration 5, and that this 'leads to minor differences in the optimal material distribution'. So Fig. 1 used a fixed move limit whose value is never given.
readings: η_max = 0.2, fixed (by analogy with Figs. 10 and 14)
η_max = 0.5, fixed (common MMA default)
η_max = 1.0, i.e. no move limit beyond the MMA asymptotes

items.entity: MMA subproblem constants and objective scaling
items.description: Sect. 3 and Appendix A only say 'the original MMA code by Svanberg' is used. The user-set constants a0, a_i, c_i, d_i, the asymptote settings, and any scaling of the compliance objective are not given.
readings: a0 = 1, a = 0, c = 1000, d = 1, default asymptote settings (0.5/1.2/0.7), compliance not scaled
Same constants, with compliance divided by its initial value
c = 1e4, d = 0 (another common topology-optimization choice), with a scaled objective

items.description: The Fig. 1 caption gives only 'maximum iterations, 100'. No convergence tolerance is stated, so it is unclear whether the run always does 100 iterations or can stop earlier.
readings: Exactly 100 iterations, no other criterion
Stop earlier when max |Δρ| < 0.01
Stop earlier when the relative change in compliance < 1e-3

items.description: Only 'density-filter radius, 2.5 (element size)' is given (Fig. 1 caption, Sect. 3.1). The weighting function and the handling at the domain boundary are not specified.
readings: Linear cone weights max(0, 2.5 − d), normalised, no boundary padding (top88-style)
Gaussian weights cut off at 2.5 elements
Helmholtz PDE filter with length scale 2.5/(2√3) elements

items.entity: Volume constraint ≤ 0.5: which density field it uses
items.description: Eq. (13) writes the volume constraint on the design variables ρ. Sect. 3 says the density filter is applied to the design variables to get the physical material layout. It is not stated whether the 0.5 limit applies to filtered (physical) or unfiltered densities.
readings: Constraint on filtered (physical) densities
Constraint on unfiltered design variables

items.entity: Non-design regions (e.g. at the loaded corner)
items.description: The Fig. 1(a) caption only marks the design domain as 'dark gray'. The text never says whether any fixed solid or void elements exist. Figs. 14 and 17 do use light-gray non-design pads, and a solid pad under the load is common for the stress version of this setting.
readings: No passive elements: the whole 30×60 grid is design domain
A small solid passive patch (a few elements) around the loaded lower-right corner
